description: Continue a sketch_agent_start task: returns every stroke newer than the given cursor (an event log, not a snapshot — nothing is skipped regardless of poll timing) plus the next cursor, reveals the result in-chat the same way render_surface does, and reports whether the drawing is complete. Call again with the returned cursor until done is true.

cursor.description: The cursor returned by the previous start/poll call. 0 to start from the beginning.

name: sketch_agent_poll
